problem_statement: Build a brand-new Press & Media page from scratch at the /press route of the codebucks27 react_portfolio (Vite + React + styled-components). The route does not exist yet (baseline renders an empty route). Construct the whole page reusing the site's existing design system: the styled-components lightTheme (body/text colors, textRgba), the fixed chrome (LogoComponent, PowerButton home button, SocialIcons rail) and the Karla heading font. The page must present: a page heading 'Press', a 'Press & Media' section subtitle, a short intro paragraph, a grid of three press-feature cards (TechCrunch, Smashing Magazine, CSS Weekly) each with a publication name heading, a date, a pull-quote, and a 'Read coverage' link, and a press-kit call-to-action block with a 'Download Press Kit' button. Static page, no interaction required. It must render without horizontal overflow on mobile and reuse the existing design system rather than introducing a new visual language.
required_content: Page heading 'Press' (h1) using the site's uppercase letter-spaced title style
Section subtitle 'Press & Media' (h2) with the theme underline border
Intro paragraph starting 'Selected features' summarising the page
Press feature card for TechCrunch (publication h3 + date + pull-quote + 'Read coverage' link)
Press feature card for Smashing Magazine (publication h3 + date + pull-quote + 'Read coverage' link)
Press feature card for CSS Weekly (publication h3 + date + pull-quote + 'Read coverage' link)
Press-kit call-to-action block with a 'Download Press Kit' button styled from the design system
design_constraints: Reuse styled-components lightTheme (props.theme.body / props.theme.text) for all colors — do not hard-code a new palette
Reuse the fixed chrome components LogoComponent, PowerButton, SocialIcons
Use the Karla / site heading font family and the existing border/box-shadow card idiom
No horizontal overflow on mobile (min-width:0 on flex children; body overflow-x hidden)
author_notes: 方案A Build: baseline 里 /press 用显式空 route element (<Route path='/press' element={<></>}/>) 留空(因为原 App 有 catch-all *→Main,不显式留空会被 Main 捕获,check A 会假过);reference 完整实现 PressPage(套 lightTheme + 复用 Logo/Power/Social + 三张 publication 卡 + press-kit 按钮);bad 用 hollow shell(只有 h1/h2/intro,缺三张卡的 h3 + 'Read coverage' a + 'Download Press Kit' button)使 dom_assertions FAIL。三份源码 md5 互不相同。repo 从候选 Sridhar-C-25__react_portfolio_2 SWAP 而来(那题是单页无 router,无法承载新 route)。
